field.label: Crypto provider for IPsec
field.help: Which of the kernel's crypto drivers encrypts the IPsec tunnels the host carries itself - on a Sophos XGS, those the coprocessor does not take. aesni is what OPNsense ships with. ossl uses OpenSSL's own AES-GCM code, which on a processor with AVX, PCLMULQDQ and MOVBE processes several blocks at once. Beside aesni, the kernel shares new sessions between the two; ossl only takes effect fully after a reboot. An open tunnel keeps its provider until its SAs are made again.
